snippet.title: Tree of Savior: NEO | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Dear Hero,

The world of Tree of Savior: NEO will open on June 12. The moment has come—not just to explore, but to fight, craft, and bond.

 With your loyal Catpal by your side, venture through ancient ruins, misty forests, and crowded cities. Every step you take brings you closer to the heartbeat of Yggdrasil.

Haven’t glimpsed what awaits? Dive into the official Gameplay PV—a preview of the journey that begins now.

June 12 — Destiny calls.

🌟 Come to Join the TOSNEO LIMITED MOUNT EVENT: https://tos.neocraftstudio.com/article/310
🎮 Pre-register Now: https://tos.neocraftstudio.com

"Adventures that Heal Souls"
